settings.heading: Do I need a gua sha tool to use this?
settings.row_content: No, you can use your fingertips, but a gua sha tool helps with an even, effective massage technique.

settings.heading: How often should I use this?
settings.row_content: Nightly use is recommended for the most consistent results, though you can use it more often if desired.

settings.heading: Is this safe for sensitive skin?
settings.row_content: Yes, but we always recommend a patch test first if you have particularly sensitive skin.

settings.heading: How long until I see results?
settings.row_content: Many customers notice smoother, firmer-looking skin within 3-4 weeks of consistent nightly use.
